1.title: Abdul El-Sayed, a Democrat, Has an Unlikely Defender: Tucker Carlson
1.summary: Mr. Carlson, the far-right podcaster, has promoted Abdul El-Sayed’s comments and sharply criticized his Republican rival in Michigan. Strategists are scratching their heads.

2.title: One Person Shot During Encounter With ICE in Austin
2.summary: The shooting in the Texas capital is the latest by federal immigration agents as the Trump administration intensifies its deportation effort.

3.title: Sikh Truck Drivers Worried Following Stabbing Attack at Rest Stop
3.summary: A crackdown on immigrant commercial drivers and a DHS social media post targeting Sikh drivers preceded the attack, which has left the Sikh community deeply unsettled.

4.title: On a Dot of France Off Canada, Carney and Macron Promote Shared Values
4.summary: The leaders of Canada and France met just after the European Union invited Canada to become its first “associate member.”

5.title: A Diplomat From Myanmar Refuses to Give Up New York City Post
5.summary: For more than five years, U Kyaw Moe Tun has refused to give up his United Nations post and a sandstone townhouse on the Upper East Side.

6.title: Man, 82, dies after beach fight with 76-year-old over sunlounger in Greece
6.summary: One eyewitness said the scene was so chaotic that screaming could be heard from the other end of the beach.
